newsitem.title: USA: ATS targets international growth, trials in U.S..
newsitem.headline: ATS targets international growth, trials in U.S..

text.p: ATS Medical Inc, which makes and markets a mechanical heart valve, said its challenge for 1997 will be to continue to grow in international markets while conducting U.S. clinical trials.

ATS had received permission to start clinical trials of its heart valve in the fourth quarter, but no U.S. revenue was generated. Since year-end, however, ATS said it has been implanting valves in the United States.

ATS said its 1996 year financial results were derived exclusively from sales outside the United States. The mid-year marketing approval of the valve in Japan was a significant factor in both the sales and profit increases, it said.

ATS reported sales for its 1996 year rose to $11.9 million from $9.3 million a year earlier. Net income for the year ended December 31, 1996 totaled $1.3 million or $0.08 a share, up from $714,524 or $0.05 per share for 1995.
Sales in the fourth quarter 1996 increased to a record $3.4 million from $2.6 million in the 1995 quarter. Net income totaled $390,967 compared with $219,509 a year earlier.
ATS said it estimates that over 14,000 valves have been implanted throughout the world and that it continues to receive reports of very favorable patient outcomes.
